descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S07 「两个模式下发交接：生成和发送行只记在发件人身上，发完马上出现后续提示，回答被存下来（Skip 什么都不存），Copy 被记录」 Send a handoff in both contexts: generated and sent rows on the sender only, the follow-up prompt right after, its answer stored (Skip stores nothing), Copy recorded

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Sending a handoff logs both the handoff generation and the send（UAT OAT-06 Test 4；TFA-94514 AC 3）
  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored（UAT OAT-06 Test 4；TFA-94514 AC 3；TFA-94609 Spec 2；TFA-94609 AC 5）
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex（UAT OAT-06 Test 6；TFA-94514 AC 6）
  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9；TFA-94514 AC 7）
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del …（UAT 3.6；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, plus a second @roundai.test colleague account in the recipient list with its own signed-in session; T0 and both accounts' rollups read at T0

When Hospital: open the handoff screen, wait for Send, send to the colleague, answer 'Not sure'; tap Copy Text. Nursing Home: the same send, then tap Skip. Then, signed in as the colleague, open the received handoff

Then Hospital: handoff_generated (hospital, patientCount >= 1) before the send, handoff_sent (hospital, handoffId, patientCount = sheet size); the question 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' with Yes / No / Not sure appears right after the send; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-06 Test 4 + TFA-94514 AC 3, per physician (Test 6). cp1/cp4 mustContain the dialog name 'Handoff follow-up question' and the full question; cp2/cp5 mustNotContain the question; cp6 (the colleague) mustNotContain it. Post-run read for the rows on both accounts, and diagnostics:list read right after each send (aiCallLog keeps 8 rows). Copy is recorded, not judged (Q20). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
